item.name: Get NFT Transfers by wallet address

request.name: Get NFT Transfers by wallet address

description.content: Get NFT transfers for a wallet, with filters like `contract_addresses` and other parameters. Supports ERC-721, ERC-1155 as well as custom contracts such as CryptoPunks and CryptoKitties.

query.description: The chain to query
List of contract addresses of transfers
List of contract addresses of transfers
The format of the token ID

The minimum block number from which to get the transfers
* Provide the param 'from_block' or 'from_date'
* If 'from_date' and 'from_block' are provided, 'from_block' will be used.
To get the reserves at this block number

The date from where to get the transfers (format in seconds or datestring accepted by momentjs)
* Provide the param 'from_block' or 'from_date'
* If 'from_date' and 'from_block' are provided, 'from_block' will be used.

Get transfers up until this date (format in seconds or datestring accepted by momentjs)
* Provide the param 'to_block' or 'to_date'
* If 'to_date' and 'to_block' are provided, 'to_block' will be used.
Should NFT last sale prices be included in the result?
The desired page size of the result.
The order of the result, in ascending (ASC) or descending (DESC)
The cursor returned in the previous response (used for getting the next page).

variable.description: (Required) The wallet address of the sender or recipient of the transfers

response.name: Returns a collection of NFT transfers

variable.description: (Required) The wallet address of the sender or recipient of the transfers

description.content: Added as a part of security scheme: apikey
